notes: Vtable slot map: DX9 slot -> SE slot follows a single uEnemy-wide offset table (0-5 same, 6->8 move, 7->9 moveEx, 8->11 sync, 9->12 draw, 12->21 kill, 29->50, 30-50 -> +23, 51-53 -> +25, 55-72 -> +26, 73-75 -> +27, 76->106, 77-84 -> +37, 87-88 -> +38, 89-102 -> +39, 103+ -> +41). Labelling fixes: 0xBD05F0 labelled uEm015::vftable was really uEm015LeftBody's vtable; real uEm015 vtable is 0xBD0448. 0xBD7BB0 labelled uEm031::vftable was uEm031::cCmnd's; real uEm031 vtable is 0xBD79D8 (116 slots = uEm016Ctrl layout). Wrong existing names fixed: 0x5F3890 uEm015::createProperty -> uEm015LeftBody::createProperty; 0x713740 uEm031::createProperty -> uEm031::cCmnd::createProperty. Conflicts kept: 0x60B500 uEm016::die (SE kill) and 0x60E7E0 uEm016::validateTargetPtrs (SE updatePtr); SE signature put in comment. uEm031 is Agnus (cCmnd 'Agnus CmndBuff', st215 scheduler), not Credo as enemy_classes.md says. ICF folding: 0x603780 (uEm015::guardMessage) shared by all 5 classes; 0x619960 = uEm016Ctrl::win = setFollower = uEm031::watch; uEm016Ctrl::setWatch/setWin folded into uEm031 copies 0x711840/0x711860; getLockOnJnt folded into getCenterJoint (uEm015 0x6056B0, uEm016 0x615390); 0x618360 uEm016::reqCamVib is also used by uEm031 and ~13 functions of other enemy classes. Scalar/vector deleting dtors are not defined functions in DX9 (loc_ labels); named with MSVC mangled names, and destructors use ??1 mangled names to keep the tilde. Accessors were matched exactly through DX9 createProperty getter/setter registrations, using property names. Motion-ID immediates confirmed same-size twin pairs, e.g. setGrabNear*, setDmgAir*, and setDmg*. DX9 main/postMain callee order matches the SE callee order 1:1, which anchors most state functions. SE-only: mostly operator new/delete/usage boilerplate, trivial set*/is* stubs inlined in DX9, SE-only uEm031 think-table checks (ckLeft/RightWalk*, ckDocument, ckHappy, ckDmgBarrierC, ckSync*), setDmgLR (inlined into interruptMessage in DX9), isWireShotStabAir, isHighTimeDamage, grabLongMessageV and getAgnus (SE-added vtable slots). uEm016Ctrl::createExCmnd/createSummonedExCmnd are ~6x larger in SE (2380/1067 vs 357/195 B), so SE has added content.
